name: zoth-netlify-ax
description: Read-only Netlify AX & Serverless Edge inspector, 14-point pre-deployment guardrail auditor, and Edge/Serverless request router simulator over 127.0.0.1:3000.

endpoints.description: Read-only inspection of repo netlify.toml, netlify/edge-functions/*, netlify/functions/*, public/ AEO discovery files, dist/ route counts, and netlify --version.
Deterministic 14-point guardrail audit and Edge/Serverless request path simulation for submitted netlify.toml, _redirects, _headers, and probePath.
Live computed Netlify platform specification and prerendered dist/ route count.
